# Broken's Enchantment Overhaul

General enchantment changes:

 * All enchantments have one level, and each item can only have one enchantment. Individual enchantments are generally more powerful and existing ones have been reworked to match this.
 * All enchantments which originally had levels will function as if they were at their maximum level.
 * Enchanted armor, tools, and weapons gain increased protection, efficiency, and durability bonuses respectively. The amount scales with item enchantability.

Enchanting Table changes:

 * The three enchantments generated by the table are unique.
 * Experience and Lapis costs are kept at a constant value regardless of slot.
 * Bookshelves and other blocks with similar effects currently do not have any effect.

Anvil changes:

 * Repairing unenchanted items does not cost any experience.
 * The experience cost of repairing items are fixed and do not increase with subsequent repairs.

Enchantments:
<details>
<summary>Tools</summary>
Tempered: Negates durability loss when mining natural non-resource blocks<br>
Excavate: Tools mine in a 3x3 radius.<br>
Silk Touch: No changes.<br>
</details>

<details>
<summary>Axe</summary>
Molten: Automatically smelts block and loot drops. Treasure enchantment.<br>
</details>

<details>
<summary>Hoe</summary>
Harvest: Harvested crops have their yield increased and automatically replant.<br>
</details>
 
<details>
<summary>Fishing Rod</summary>
 Grapple: Increases reeling strength. Reeling while the bobber is attached to a block pulls the user towards it.<br>
 Deep fryer: Cooks caught fish and sets reeled targets on fire.<br>
 Luck of the Sea: Additionally increases fishing speed.<br>
</details>

<details>
<summary>Helmet</summary>
Filtered: Shortens harmful effect durations while extending beneficial ones.<br>
Insight: Increases looting level and luck scaling with total armor enchantability.<br>
Dexterity: Prevents underwater mining slowdown and increases reach distance with tools.<br>
</details>

<details>
<summary>Chestplate</summary>
Vitality: Increases maximum health and healing effectiveness.<br>
Barrier: Grants a barrier which limits incoming damage. Recharges over time.<br>
Adaptive: Gradually increases resistance when taking damage of the same type. Resets when taking damage from a different type.<br>
Thorns: Chance to reflect a percentage of damage taken. Effect increased while at or below half health. Effect no longer damages armor.<br>
</details>

<details>
<summary>Leggings</summary>
Rush: Increases damage resistance while at or below half health. Effect increased while sprinting.<br>
Scavenger: Loot drops are pulled to the wearer and temporarily boost armor toughness.<br>
Stabilize: Reduces knockback and prevents explosions from breaking nearby blocks.<br>
Swift sneak: Additionally reduces monster awareness radius.<br>
</details>

<details>
<summary>Boots</summary>
Agility: Increases step height and grants extra movement speed depending on total armor.<br>
Friction: Allows sliding down and jumping off walls for a short duration.<br>
Depth Strider: Additionally allows water-specific bonuses on land.<br>
Soul Speed: Speed bonus is also active while at or below a quarter of health.<br>
Frost Walker: No changes.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Sword</summary>
Sweeping Edge: Sweeping attacks deal extra damage for each target hit.<br>
Smite: Extra damage is also applied to targets with negative status effects.<br>
Fire Aspect: Additional strikes on burning targets increases burn damage, up to 3.<br>
</details>

<details>
<summary>Bow</summary>
Power Shot: Arrows can be overcharged, significantly increasing damage and knockback. Weapon glows red when fully overcharged.<br>
Flame: Additional hits on burning targets increase burn damage up to 4.<br>
Barrage: Significantly increases draw speed and returns hit arrows.<br>
</details>

<details>
<summary>Crossbow</summary>
Volley: Arrow hits automatically reload the weapon.<br>
Multishot: Arrows ignore iframes; All 3 arrows can deal full damage to a single target.<br>
Piercing: No changes.<br>
</details>

<details>
<summary>Trident</summary>
Impaling: Deals extra damage to any target in water or rain instead of only aquatic-type targets.<br>
Channeling: Functions in any weather<br>
Riptide: No changes.<br>
</details>

<details>
<summary>Mace</summary>
Breach: Fully reworked; Smash attacks boost armor piercing and speed of the next few attacks. Weapon glows red while this bonus is active.<br>
Blacksmith: Removes durability loss. Smash attack kills repair a random equipped item.<br>
Density: No changes.<br>
Wind burst: No changes.<br>
</details>

Configuration:

 * Enchantments can be changed with datapacks. It is possible to revert changes made to vanilla enchantments in this manner.
 * This mod contains some tags which can be modified with datapacks.  * Anvil and enchantment costs can be changed in the config file.
 * There is an experimental config option which disables the core enchantment and anvil changes for extended customization. Intended for datapack developers who know what they are doing.

Credits:

 * Moriyashiine: This mod is inspired by theirs: [Enchancement](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/enchancement)
 * Quark team: For use of their red enchantment glint

Disclaimers:

 * This mod is in a beta state. Expect large changes over an extended period of time.
 * This mod won't be backported. It would require a full rewrite of everything from scratch due to large changes in the enchantment system.
 * This mod makes a number of invasive changes to enchantment code in order to function. If you use this with Apotheosis (which makes _even more_ invasive changes) or Enchancement there will be issues.
